NativeWorkCheckoutObservation.rules: Exact keys; source fields equal selectedWork. cwd is the admitted canonical owning checkout; branch is the exact full refs/heads/... symbolic ref. Receipt is fixed-owner source evidence, not authenticated native authorship.

observeNativeWorkCheckout.behavior: Two bounded local observations verify canonical checkout/repository top-level roots, shared canonical git-common-dir custody, checkout HEAD commit and attached symbolic branch. Uses explicit argv, proven common gitReadEnvironment, no shell/fetch/checkout/hooks; total deadline10000ms and per-command output <=8192 bytes.
observeNativeWorkCheckout.qualification: Local checkout address and source-route readiness only. Working-file cleanliness, remote freshness, native authorship, execution permission and actual execution remain unproved.

exportedContract.NativeContextLoader: gitWork optional provider surface additionally admits gitReadEnvironment; it is required only for an observed v2 checkout route. Old loaders without it retain historical behavior.
exportedContract.readHomeContextContractValue: Overloads preserve HomeContextContract v1 return, return HomeContextContractV2 for typed v2 input, and NativeHomeContextContract for unknown input. Prospective parsing reads no profile bytes and publishes no native files.

projectHomeContext.callerRule: The fixed native owner supplies the proven selected view and source root; handleHook supplies the real observeNativeWorkCheckout callback. Direct callers must preserve the same trusted callback boundary.
projectHomeContext.behavior: Only an exact qualified selected Work plus valid owner-pinned and locally reobserved receipt enables the source route. All authority/nativePermission/model-budget flags remain false. Held or oversized required semantics withdraw route readiness and hold the complete pointer rather than truncate purpose, decisions, originals or effect fences.
